newsitem.title: FRANCE: Morocco buys 40,000 tonnes French Coface wheat.
newsitem.headline: Morocco buys 40,000 tonnes French Coface wheat.

text.p: Morocco bought a total of 40,000 tonnes of French soft wheat for February 5-15 delivery under a Coface export credit, European grain traders said on Thursday.
Morocco bought 20,000 tonnes of French wheat at $172.49 per tonne, including freight and the cost of the Coface credit for delivery to the ports of Tangier and Nador.
Morocco also bought 20,000 tonnes of French wheat at $165 per tonne, including freight and Coface, for delivery to the port of Agadir, they said. -- Paris newsroom +331 4221 5432
